findings.summary: Persisted policy mutation cannot reject the 101st active channel
findings.details: The pure planner has a CapacityExceeded check, but the Confect mutation reads sourceChannels with .take(100) before invoking it. When an organization has 101 joined/active Slack channels, the capability will only validate the first 100 rows and can accept a bulk policy request instead of returning the required typed CapacityExceeded failure.

findings.summary: Persisted policy changes do not preserve immutable epoch/generation contract
findings.details: The mutation never reads existing channelRoutingPolicies or channelDeliveryPolicies, so buildBulkPolicyPlan always receives empty existing policy arrays and emits policyEpoch/deliveryGeneration 1. Repeated changes or rollback cannot create the required next immutable epoch/generation, and the implementation does not move/deactivate the active pointer based on prior policy state.
